Container.Name: dockge-enhanced
Container.Overview: Manage Compose stacks with Dockge-Enhanced on Unraid. Docker Compose is included; no Compose plugin is needed. Keep the stacks host/container paths identical. Enable Unraid Autostart. The Docker socket grants host-level control: review backups and cleanup settings. Installation and permissions: extra/unraid/README.md.

Config.Name: Enhanced data
Config.Description: Persistent Enhanced settings and database. Do not share this directory between running instances.

Config.Name: Compose stacks
Config.Description: Host path, container path and DOCKGE_STACKS_DIR must match exactly. Change all three together.

Config.Name: DOCKGE_STACKS_DIR
Config.Description: Must match both sides of the stacks mount.

Config.Name: Docker socket
Config.Description: Grants control over ALL host containers, including production. Not a security sandbox.
